name: Epic Games Launcher
layout_summary: Left navigation sidebar: Store, Library, Unreal Engine, Quick Launch list, and Downloads at bottom-left. Top bar in Store: 'Search store' box at top-left, Discover/Browse/News links, and profile avatar at top-right. Library view shows a grid of game tiles with a search/filter panel on the right.
avoid_traps: In Library, clicking a grayed-out tile starts installation rather than launching; installed games have full-color artwork or 'Launch' under Quick Launch in the left sidebar.
Do NOT click Unreal Engine tab unless specifically asked for Unreal Engine tools.

open_library.visual_fallback: smart_click('Library icon below Store on left side')
open_library.verify: Main area displays grid of owned game tiles

open_store.visual_fallback: smart_click('Store icon at top of left sidebar')
open_store.verify: Epic Games Store front page loads

search_store.primary: smart_type('Search store input at top-left of main area', query, submit=true)
search_store.visual_fallback: smart_click('Search store at top-left') -> type_text(query) -> press_key('enter')

search_library.primary: smart_type('Search library filter input', game_name, submit=true)
search_library.visual_fallback: smart_click('Search filter input in Library') -> type_text(game_name)
search_library.verify: Library grid filters to matching games

launch_game.primary: smart_click('game tile in Library or under Quick Launch in left sidebar')
launch_game.visual_fallback: smart_click('Launch under game tile in Library')
launch_game.verify: Game tile shows 'Running' and the game process starts
